items.title: Getting updates
items.description: Methods and types for receiving updates.

children.name: Update
children.description:
This object represents an incoming update.
At most one of the optional parameters can be present in any given update.

annotations.description: The update's unique identifier.
annotations.name: update_id

annotations.description: New incoming message of any kind - text, photo, sticker, etc.
annotations.name: message

annotations.description: New incoming callback query.
annotations.name: callback_query

children.name: getUpdates
children.description: Use this method to receive incoming updates using long polling. Returns an Array of Update objects.

annotations.description: Identifier of the first update to be returned.
annotations.name: offset

annotations.description: Limits the number of updates to be retrieved. Values between 1-100 are accepted.
annotations.name: limit

annotations.description: Timeout in seconds for long polling.
annotations.name: timeout

annotations.description: A list of the update types you want your bot to receive.
annotations.name: allowed_updates

items.title: Available types
items.description: All types used in the Bot API responses.

children.name: User
children.description: This object represents a Telegram user or bot.

annotations.description: Unique identifier for this user or bot.
annotations.name: id

annotations.description: True, if this user is a bot.
annotations.name: is_bot

annotations.description: User's or bot's first name.
annotations.name: first_name

annotations.description: User's or bot's last name.
annotations.name: last_name

annotations.description: User's or bot's username.
annotations.name: username

annotations.description: Unique message identifier inside this chat.
annotations.name: message_id

annotations.description: Sender of the message.
annotations.name: from

annotations.description: Date the message was sent in Unix time.
annotations.name: date

annotations.description: The actual UTF-8 text of the message.
annotations.name: text

annotations.description: Available sizes of the photo.
annotations.name: photo

children.name: ChatMember
children.description: This object contains information about one member of a chat. Currently, the following 6 types of chat members are supported: ChatMemberOwner, ChatMemberAdministrator, ChatMemberMember, ChatMemberRestricted, ChatMemberLeft, ChatMemberBanned.

items.title: Available methods
items.description: All methods in the Bot API.

children.name: getMe
children.description: A simple method for testing your bot's authentication token. Requires no parameters. Returns basic information about the bot in form of a User object.

children.name: sendMessage
children.description: Use this method to send text messages. On success, the sent Message is returned.

annotations.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target channel.
annotations.name: chat_id

annotations.description: Text of the message to be sent.
annotations.name: text

annotations.type: InlineKeyboardMarkup or ReplyKeyboardMarkup or ReplyKeyboardRemove or ForceReply
annotations.description: Additional interface options.
annotations.name: reply_markup

children.name: deleteWebhook
children.description: Use this method to remove webhook integration if you decide to switch back to getUpdates. Returns True on success.

annotations.description: Pass True to drop all pending updates.
annotations.name: drop_pending_updates
